reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Liverpool FC are favoured at 70%, against 14% for Fenerbahçe SK and 16% for the draw. Liverpool FC carry 280 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Fenerbahçe SK 0.7 points per game, Liverpool FC 1.8. They average 2.0 points per game on the road this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 4.29 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 80%. Across their last five, Fenerbahçe SK and Liverpool FC have scored 1.7 and conceded 2.6 a game between them. Liverpool FC are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Fenerbahçe SK.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
